# MathSDK

> Native, embeddable symbolic + numeric math engine exposed as a stable,
> exception-free C ABI. SymEngine is the private symbolic core; capabilities
> SymEngine doesn't provide are implemented as private C++ modules and exposed
> only when a real operation needs them. No Python/SymPy runtime, on any
> platform.

Only `native/include/mathsdk/math_sdk.h` is public. Every function returns a
`MathSdkStatus` and writes results through output pointers; strings are
caller-owned and released with `math_sdk_free_string`. Read the doc comment
above each declaration in that header before assuming a function covers your
case — it states the function's exact coverage and ceiling.

## Status codes

`MATHSDK_STATUS_OK`, `_INVALID_ARGUMENT`, `_PARSE_ERROR`, `_DIVISION_BY_ZERO`,
`_DOMAIN_ERROR`, `_NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, `_INTERNAL_ERROR`. Never repurposed across
releases — see CHANGELOG.md.

## API surface (14 functions)

- `math_sdk_version` — SDK version string.
- `math_sdk_evaluate` — parse + canonicalize an exact expression (arithmetic, fractions, powers, roots, constants, symbolic expressions).
- `math_sdk_evaluate_steps` — same as `evaluate`, plus a JSON step-by-step reduction trace.
- `math_sdk_substitute` — replace a symbol with a value (numeric or symbolic), then canonicalize.
- `math_sdk_evaluate_numeric` — evaluate to a `double` (no arbitrary precision).
- `math_sdk_derivative` — derivative with respect to a symbol, any order.
- `math_sdk_solve` — single-variable equation solving, finite root sets only.
- `math_sdk_solve_linear_system` — linear systems; guarded against singular/inconsistent systems.
- `math_sdk_limit` — limit at a point, one- or two-sided, via series expansion.
- `math_sdk_integral` — indefinite/definite integral over a rule table, verified by differentiating the result back.
- `math_sdk_series` — Taylor/Laurent expansion around a point.
- `math_sdk_matrix_op` — determinant, inverse, transpose, addition, multiplication on dense matrices.
- `math_sdk_ode_solve_separable` — closed-form solution of a separable first-order ODE.
- `math_sdk_free_string` — releases any string this API returned.

## Language bindings

- Flutter/Dart: `flutter_package/` — federated `ffiPlugin: true` package, builds native code from source via CMake, no prebuilt binary bundled.
- Any other language/framework: implement against the C ABI directly; see `docs/CONSUMERS.md` for the ownership/status-code/portability rules a binding must follow.
